# PolicyLinks

The footer’s row of links. Each opens its text in a `Modal`, so the shopper never leaves the checkout, and focus returns to the link when it closes.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/policylinks)

## Usage

```tsx
<PolicyLinks
  policies={[
    { id: 'refund', label: 'Refund policy', content: <p>We have a 30-day return policy…</p> },
    { id: 'privacy', label: 'Privacy policy', content: <PrivacyText /> },
  ]}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `policies` | `Policy[]` | { id, label, title?, content }. The modal’s title defaults to the label. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `PolicyLinks.module.css`
- `PolicyLinks.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/checkout/CheckoutProvider.tsx`](../CheckoutProvider.tsx)
- [`src/icons`](../../icons)
- [`src/labels.ts`](../../labels.ts)
- [`src/lib/money.ts`](../../lib/money.ts)
- [`src/lib/motion.ts`](../../lib/motion.ts)
- [`src/primitives/Modal`](../../primitives/Modal)
- [`src/primitives/Text`](../../primitives/Text)
- [`src/theme`](../../theme)
- [`src/types.ts`](../../types.ts)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
